messages:
Jordan (Mktg): Hey @eng-runtime, we need a reproducible rerun for next week's webinar. Objective: verify launch latency/cost claims, capture demo-friendly artifacts (traces, per-token cost CSVs). Can you run a controlled sweep and upload everything to S3?
Alex (eng-runtime): Quick q: which model variant(s), region, and exact metrics do you need? Also what's the hard deadline?
Jordan (Mktg): Models: redwood-large-v1 (fp16) and redwood-large-v1-4bit (quantized). Region: us-west-2. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, coldstart vs warmed, throughput (tokens/sec), per-token cost, and 3 representative full traces we can present live. Deadline: artifacts by Tue EOD so marketing can finalize slides.
Maya (Mktg): We want stratified cohorts: short (<=64 tokens), medium (200-512), long (1024-2048). Total ~200 samples split across cohorts. Use a fixed RNG seed for repeatability.
Alex (eng-runtime): Got it. How many samples per cohort? And confirm identical warmup policy for both fp16 and 4bit runs?
Jordan (Mktg): short=80, medium=80, long=40. Warmup: 5 min burst at 10 RPS per replica, then steady test load. Use the same warmup for both variants. Seed: 2026. Tag everything with webinar-6171717171.
Sam (Mktg): Can we also get token-level CSVs (token, latency_ms, cost_usd) for the 3 representative traces? Want to show token-level improvements for quantized variant side-by-side.
Priya (eng-runtime): We'll produce per-token CSVs for the representative traces plus an aggregated CSV. We'll include a manifest (model version, docker image, runtime flags, exact command). Example run command we'll use:
```bash
# simplified run_bench command
python run_bench.py --model redwood-large-v1 \
  --variant fp16 \
  --region us-west-2 \
  --cohorts short,medium,long \
  --samples 200 \
  --seed 2026 \
  --warmup_secs 300 \
  --warmup_rps 10 \
  --trace_output s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/6171717171/
```
Priya (eng-runtime): We'll run the fp16 baseline first, then the 4bit quantized variant with identical traffic and warmup. Warmup will populate KV cache. We'll also emit an env manifest string in the bucket so anyone can reproduce the exact runtime image and flags.
Alex (eng-runtime): Note: coldstarts for quantized images can be noisy. We'll collect at least 5 independent coldstart samples per cohort to get a stable estimate. Also need signoff for burst capacity during warmup (cost).
Jordan (Mktg): Approved for burst capacity. Please include a pre-run cost estimate in the manifest so Finance can review before it runs.
Maya (Mktg): For the deck we want 3 full traces (one per cohort) for both fp16 and 4bit. Mark those trace IDs in the manifest and include token-level CSVs for them.
Priya (eng-runtime): We'll pick the median-latency trace per cohort to be the representative one and list the trace IDs in the manifest. We'll also add a short README describing known nondeterminism sources.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for benchmark-run/webinar-6171717171 (jobs: bench-run, trace-export)
Alex (eng-runtime): Timeline: schedule runs tonight (non-peak), finish by Tue 17:00 PT, upload artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/6171717171/ (manifest, per-token CSVs, aggregated stats CSV, sample payloads, README).
Sam (Mktg): Awesome. Ping here when bucket is populated and I'll pull traces for slides.
Priya (eng-runtime): Will ping with S3 link when upload completes. Sample payload we'll use:
{"prompt":"Summarize the operational risks of a high-throughput inference platform in 2 sentences","max_tokens":120}
Alex (eng-runtime): FYI: we run with seed=2026 for generation but some kernels and async ops introduce tiny nondeterminism; we'll surface that in the README and include checksums for the CSVs.
Jordan (Mktg): Thanks team. Priority: clean reproducible artifacts for the live demo. Tag anything we need access to with webinar-6171717171. :thumbsup: 
Priya (eng-runtime): ACK. Will update here with the s3 link and a short run summary when done. :white_check_mark:
